title: Flail of the Vortex

sources.title: Electrified Flail
markers: | description = Clout a foe with your lightning-suffused flail and {{SmCond|Stunned|Stun}} them.

sources.title: Tenacity
markers: | description = When you miss a melee attack, you deal {{DamageText|[[Strength]] [[Modifier]]|Bludgeoning}} damage (minimum of 1) anyway.

summary: Air Myrmidon flail. The summon and Wild Shape versions can deal Lightning damage.

fields.Availability: Inaccessible as normal equipment. Air Myrmidons are Permanently Armed.
fields.Variants: Player summon and Wild Shape versions list +3 and 1d8 extra Lightning. The NPC version is unenchanted and lacks the Lightning rider.
fields.Electrified Flail: Action. Weapon damage plus 1d10 Lightning. DC 13 Constitution or Stunned for 2 turns. Tenacity is listed but does not trigger while polymorphed.
fields.Base value: 50 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence.
